title: first assertHealthy after evaluate is unpinned; manifest wrongly calls its removal equivalent
detail: Dropping budget.assertHealthy() right after ask() in evaluateNode survives the whole suite. It is not equivalent: a budget failure swallowed inside the evaluator (heuristic fallback), with score below lower and no tavily, makes refineNode return the 'No supported internal source' success early, so the sticky failure is never rethrown (and tavily can run). The original refuses with 'budget exhausted'. Also the refusal and error tests are not in the frozen baseline (self-comparison only after the refactor).
fix_direction: Add the scenario: boundedX({swallowedHuge:true}) with scoreFnForComplete returning 0.05 and no tavily; assert askV2 rejects /budget exhausted/ and calls == ['ask.select_nodes']. Optionally extend the baseline to the refusal and error tests.
